settings.title: Return & Cancellation
settings.content:
Returns

We take great care to ensure your order is delivered safely. In the unlikely event you receive a damaged or defective product:

  • Inform the delivery personnel immediately.
  • Report the issue to our Customer Support team right away.

All complaints are reviewed within 72 hours. If confirmed, we will arrange a replacement, return, or other suitable resolution. If any assembly parts are missing, please notify Customer Support so we can ship the required components promptly.

Cancellations

Orders may be cancelled within 24 hours of placement.

settings.title: Care Instructions
settings.content:
Cleaning

  • Wipe dust with a soft cotton cloth.
  • Use a slightly moistened cloth, avoiding excess water.
  • Clean only with water — avoid chemicals or harsh cleaners.

Avoid Chemicals

  • Do not use chemical-based cleaners or polyurethane paints.
  • Chemicals can damage the natural finish and reduce durability.

Surface Care

  • Use coasters or mats for hot, cold, or wet items to protect the polish.
  • Wipe spills immediately with a soft, dry cloth to prevent stains.
  • For scratches, burns, or residue, use fine-grit sandpaper, then reapply mineral oil.

Additional Tips

  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight as it may fade the polish/colour.
  • Do not drag furniture (especially beds) while repositioning, as it may weaken joints.

settings.title: Quality Promise & Disclaimer
settings.content:
Quality Promise

  • All wooden products undergo a 3-step treatment for protection against termites, borers, and pests.
  • Wood is seasoned for optimum moisture content to minimise seasonal expansion or contraction.
  • Every product is tested through a 3-stage quality check with over 50+ checkpoints before dispatch.

Disclaimer

  • Accessories shown in images are for display purposes only and are not included, unless specified.
  • Natural wood grains may vary slightly from piece to piece, reflecting the uniqueness of solid wood.
  • Handcrafted details or hand-painted designs may show minor variations from images.
  • Due to differences in screen settings, slight variations in fabric colour or wood finish may occur.
